title: Baton scientific knowledge graph version 1
description: Draft structured contract. Node and edge assertions retain authors, method and evidence references, scientific applicability, assumptions, limits and uncertainty. Schema validation establishes record structure. Authors retain responsibility for scientific content.

oneOf.description: Evidence or reasoning bears positively on the target under the stated context.
Evidence or reasoning identifies a defeater, weakness or competing interpretation.
Source and target cannot jointly hold within the asserted overlap.
Source states the logical complement of the target in the stated context.
Source entails the target by the cited argument and assumptions.
The source argument establishes the target under its explicit premises and context.
The source argument refutes the target under the stated context.
An authored causal explanation links source to target and states its identification basis.
The source and target have a stated empirical association.
Two hypotheses offer alternative explanations of the same question.
A study or observation repeats an earlier procedure and states agreement and differences.
The source was constructed or interpreted using the target.
A study or hypothesis addresses the target scientific question.
A study produced the target record.
The source contributes to the rationale for a proposed action or decision.
The source revises a prior record while preserving its identity and content.

entityReference.description: An identified physical, digital or conceptual entity. Subject slots name the thing whose property is observed or asserted. The URI identifies the entity; the optional label describes it.
